channel.title: IBM Corporation — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by IBM Corporation (ibm).

item.title: CVE-2026-93907 · 8.1 HIGH 🌩️ — IBM WebSphere Application Server is affected by a bypass authentication vulnerability
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server 8.5, and 9.0 could allow a remote attacker to bypass authentication by exploiting a flaw in the CSIv2 inbound propagation handler.

item.title: CVE-2026-95680 · 8 HIGH — IBM WebSphere Application Server is affected by an authorization bypass
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server 8.5, and 9.0 could allow an authenticated attacker to bypass authorization leading to administrative impersonation across the cell.

item.title: CVE-2026-103499 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — IBM WebSphere Application Server and WebSphere Application Server Liberty are affected by a denial of service
item.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server - Liberty 17.0.0.3 through 26.0.0.10 and IBM WebSphere Application Server 8.5, and 9.0 Liberty could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to cause a denial of service due to uncontrolled resource consumption.

item.title: CVE-2026-17484 · 5.3 MEDIUM 🌩️ — IBM i is Information Disclosure
